metadata.title: That 1 kill where I didn’t even aim but Valorant said ‘Take it and run, champ’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just steal a kill without even trying?
Enemy probably AFK or questioning life.
Click if your best plays are total accidents!
Valorant logic at its finest.

Tap if you’ve ever gotten kills you didn’t deserve!

#valorant #luckshot #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
